name: wayz_iotkit
description: RT-Thread positioning client for the WAYZ location cloud. Scans nearby WiFi APs (and optionally GNSS / cellular data), uploads them over HTTP and returns the position (gcj02 / wgs84 / bd09), POI and address. Supports RT-Thread 4.1 to 6.0; HTTP by default so no TLS component or device certificate is required.
description_zh: WAYZ 定位云的 RT-Thread 定位组件。扫描周边 WiFi(可选 GNSS / 基站数据), 通过 HTTP 上传到定位云, 返回经纬度(gcj02 / wgs84 / bd09)、POI 与门牌地址。适配 RT-Thread 4.1 ~ 6.0; 默认使用 HTTP, 无需 TLS 组件与设备证书。
